# spec/sample/eval

`spec/sample/eval` — evaluates a property's call-free expressions, its
`where` above all, as the generated test does: + - * % wrap to their
operands' integer type, `and` and `or` stop at the first deciding operand,
and `unwrap(null)` is undefined, which makes `where` false.

Generated from [src/spec/sample/eval.ts](https://github.com/amritk/vector/blob/main/src/spec/sample/eval.ts).

### sampleEval

Evaluates a call-free expression. A `let` evaluates each binding in turn
before its body, as the generated test does.

```ts

  e: Expr,
  env: Map<string, SampleValue>,
): Result<SampleValue, string>
```

<scalar-field name="e" type="Expr" required>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="Result&lt;SampleValue, string&gt;">

</scalar-field>

### sampleHolds

Whether an input is in a property's domain: its `where` evaluates to true.
An undefined `where` (an `unwrap(null)`) is false.

```ts
function sampleHolds(
  where: Expr | null,
  env: Map<string, SampleValue>,
): Result<boolean, string>
```

<scalar-field name="where" type="Expr | null" required>

the property's `where`, or null for none

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="env" type="Map&lt;string, SampleValue&gt;" required>

the input

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="Result&lt;boolean, string&gt;">

</scalar-field>
